## Feature Request

Thank you for suggesting a new feature! We appreciate your ideas.

### Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

### Use Case

What problem would this feature solve? How would it benefit users?

### Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this feature should work.

### Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

### Additional Context

Any other information, mockups, or examples that would help us understand the request.

### Checklist

- [ ] I have searched the existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have checked that this feature is not already implemented
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals and scope
